text:
@ashokpan @drsangitareddy Strategic distortion & distraction won't help . 
While cheerleaders flood my timeline with "Viksit Bharat" reels, let's talk what they hide: deepening hate, broken institutions, jobless youth & economic pain. 

12 years in, the gaps are glaring. It is not  denialism but reality.

Hate & Division on Steroids has become  glaring .
1,318 hate speech events in 2025 alone (India Hate Lab) — avg 4 per day, 98% targeting Muslims. Manipur burns for 3+ years: hundreds dead, thousands displaced, fresh violence in 2026 with hostages & bombs. Bulldozers, boycotts & impunity. "Sabka Saath" was a slogan, not policy.

Our  Institutions have been  emasculated.CBI, ED, RBI, EC, Judiciary — all under pressure. Selective raids on opposition, electoral bonds saga, press freedom rankings tanked. As per global reports there has been democratic backsliding . One-man show replacing checks & balances. Independent bodies? Now extended arms of the regime. Supreme Court stands a mute spectator- deranged.

Economy is in a mess & there is high unemployment. K-Shaped Disaster
Unemployment hovers ~5-7% (CMIE/PLFS), youth & educated worst hit. Demonetization wrecked informal sector. Farmer protests ignored. Inequality has peaked .billionaires boom, rural distress lingers. Post-COVID "recovery" left millions in underemployment. Promises of 2cr jobs/year? Vanished.
 
Further, COVID second wave chaos (oxygen crisis, migrations). China border tensions unresolved. Federalism strained — Centre vs opposition states via agencies & funds. Welfare schemes exist but implementation & ground impact questioned amid leakages & PR focus.

Yes there have been mega infra & global summits . But social cohesion fractured, institutions weakened, jobs scarce for aspirational India. Non-credible   data  is now being used as  propaganda.
We citizens are really sick of Photo-ops .
author: bismil_prasad

text:
@the_hindu https://t.co/dbObr5UnsG

*🚨 Meitei-Naga Info War EXPOSED: Desperate Lies After Loibol Khullen Massacre*

Right after the cold-blooded killings in Loibol Khullen, a gang of Meitei and Naga pages — Depu Panmei, Manipur Broadcast, Kamei Pkamson, The Naga Prey, Yarshokmi Golmei Hanshi, Ruangmei Today, Manipur Pao — unleashed a flood of identical bullshit.

Their scripted lies flooded social media: _“Internal Kuki clash”, “Simple exchange of gunfire”, “No link to NSCN-IM or ZUF-K”_.

These clowns couldn’t even get the village name right — half of them kept calling it “Leivon” while spreading their garbage narrative.

But the truth came out fast.

Yet the condemnations poured in immediately from Deputy CM Nemcha Kipgen, Saikul MLA Kimneo Hangshing, Saitu MLA Haokholet Kipgen, SAHILCA, Kuki Inpi Sadar Hills, Kuki Women Union, Kuki Inpi Manipur, and multiple Kuki organisations.

Despite these strong condemnations, the network kept pumping out the same lies, same images, and same scripted narrative within hours.

This was not random posts. This was a deliberate, coordinated disinformation operation — exposed by their own stupidity and synchronized timing.

Indian Army @easterncomd must take serious note.

This same information warfare machinery will target you next. They are already preparing the narrative battlefield to brand you as villains whenever it suits their agenda.

Manipur Police @manipur_police, listen up:
Investigate this entire network immediately. Track every account, every coordination, every funding source. Charge them for spreading fake news, incitement, and endangering public order.

No more protection for killers.
No more cover-ups.Expose these frauds. Arrest the propagandists. Deliver justice NOW.

@official_dgar : How's everything? All good? How was the vacation?

@Spearcorps : What Spear? All you have is a Stick.
